map.HTTP 状态码由三位数字组成，首位数字表示响应类别，用于告知客户端请求的处理结: A status code is three digits long, and the first digit denotes the response class, telling the client how its request was handled.

map.：301 为永久重定向（会被浏览器缓存），302 为临时重定向。: : 301 is a permanent redirect (cached by the browser) and 302 a temporary one.

map.定位接口故障：看 4xx 与 5xx 的分界判断责任方——4xx 多半是请求参数: Locating an API fault: the 4xx/5xx boundary tells you who is responsible — 4xx is usually a bad request parameter or an auth problem, while 5xx means the server failed to handle it.
map.核对重定向语义：确认 301（永久，会被浏览器长期缓存）与 302（临时）用对了: Checking redirect semantics: make sure 301 (permanent, cached by the browser long-term) and 302 (temporary) are used in the right places — a mistaken 301 sends users to the wrong address for a long time.
map.200 OK、301 永久重定向、404 未找到、500 服务端错误。: 200 OK, 301 permanent redirect, 404 not found, 500 server error.
map.401 和 403 有什么区别？: What is the difference between 401 and 403?
map.401 Unauthorized 表示「未认证」——请求缺少或携带了无效凭据，通: 401 Unauthorized means "not authenticated" — the request is missing credentials or carries invalid ones, and it usually comes with a WWW-Authenticate header describing the scheme. 403 Forbidden means "authenticated but not permitted": the server knows who you are and simply refuses. Conflating the two leaves clients unable to tell whether to sign in or to request access.
map.为什么 Nginx 日志里出现 499？: Why does 499 show up in my Nginx logs?
map.499 是 Nginx 自定义的状态码，表示客户端在服务器返回响应前主动关闭了连: 499 is a custom Nginx status code meaning the client closed the connection before the server returned a response (the user closed the page, or a front-end timeout aborted it). It is not a standard HTTP status code, so when debugging, check whether the backend is too slow or the front-end timeout too short rather than looking for 4xx error-handling logic.

map.服务器在最终响应前先返回提示头（如 Link），供客户端预加载资源（RFC 82: The server sends hint headers (such as Link) before the final response so the client can preload resources (RFC 8297).
map.响应由代理返回，内容与源服务器可能不同（正文引据表举例的标准码）。: The response was returned by a proxy and may differ from the origin server's content (a standard code cited in the reference table).
map.请求成功，提示客户端重置当前文档视图/表单。: The request succeeded; the client should reset the current document view or form.
map.资源有多个可选表示，客户端需自行选择。: The resource has several representations; the client must choose one.
map.响应在另一个 URL，客户端应以 GET 获取（常用于 POST 后跳转）。: The response is at another URL; the client should retrieve it with GET (commonly used after a POST redirect).
map.资源必须通过代理访问（已弃用）。: The resource must be accessed through a proxy (deprecated).
map.服务器要求请求携带 Content-Length。: The server requires the request to include a Content-Length header.
map.请求头中的条件（如 If-Match）未满足。: A conditional request header (such as If-Match) was not satisfied.
map.请求 URI 超过服务器允许的长度。: The request URI is longer than the server is willing to interpret.
map.服务器无法满足 Expect 请求头（如 100-continue）。: The server cannot meet the requirements of the Expect header (for example, 100-continue).
map.请求被发到无法响应该资源的服务器（如 HTTP/2 连接复用错误）。: The request was sent to a server that cannot produce a response for that resource (for example, an HTTP/2 connection reuse error).
map.服务器不愿处理可能重放的请求（TLS 早期数据相关，RFC 8470）。: The server is unwilling to process a request that may be replayed (related to TLS early data, RFC 8470).
map.客户端需切换到其他协议（如 HTTP/1.1 → HTTP/2）。: The client must switch to another protocol (for example, HTTP/1.1 → HTTP/2).
map.服务器要求请求带条件头（如 If-Match）以避免丢失更新。: The server requires conditional headers (such as If-Match) to avoid lost updates.
map.请求头字段过多或过大，服务器拒绝处理。: The request header fields are too numerous or too large for the server to process.
map.因法律/监管要求不可访问（RFC 7725，如版权封禁）。: Access is unavailable for legal or regulatory reasons (RFC 7725, such as a copyright block).
map.服务器配置错误：变体资源自身又参与内容协商（RFC 2295）。: The server is misconfigured: the variant resource itself participates in content negotiation (RFC 2295).
map.服务器无法存储完成请求所需的内容（WebDAV）。: The server cannot store the content needed to complete the request (WebDAV).
map.服务器在处理请求时检测到无限循环（WebDAV）。: The server detected an infinite loop while processing the request (WebDAV).
map.服务器需要更多扩展才能满足请求（RFC 2774）。: The server requires further extensions to fulfill the request (RFC 2774).
map.请求需要身份验证（通常需登录）；与 403「已认证但无权限」区分。: The request requires authentication (usually sign-in); distinct from 403, where the client is authenticated but lacks permission.
map.请求的 Range 超出资源可返回范围。: The requested Range cannot be satisfied for this resource.
map.客户端应继续发送请求的剩余部分。: The client should continue sending the remainder of the request.
map.服务器已理解客户端请求，并通过 Upgrade 头通知切换协议。: The server understood the request and uses the Upgrade header to signal a protocol switch.
map.服务器已收到请求并正在处理，但尚未有响应。: The server has received the request and is processing it, but no response is available yet.
map.请求已成功处理，响应体为请求的资源。: The request succeeded and the response body contains the requested resource.
map.请求成功且服务器创建了新资源。: The request succeeded and the server created a new resource.
map.请求已接受但尚未处理完成（异步）。: The request was accepted but processing is not complete (asynchronous).
map.请求成功但无需返回响应体（如 DELETE）。: The request succeeded and there is no response body (for example, DELETE).
map.服务器已处理部分 GET 请求（Range 请求）。: The server fulfilled part of a GET request (Range request).
map.资源已永久移动到新 URL，搜索引擎应更新索引。: The resource has moved permanently to a new URL; search engines should update their index.
map.资源临时移动到其他 URL。: The resource has temporarily moved to another URL.
map.客户端缓存资源未修改，可继续使用缓存。: The cached copy is unchanged and can be reused.
map.与 302 类似，但保持原请求方法不变。: Similar to 302, but the original request method is preserved.
map.与 301 类似，但保持原请求方法不变。: Similar to 301, but the original request method is preserved.
map.服务器无法理解请求语法。: The server could not understand the request syntax.
map.服务器拒绝请求（已认证但无权限）。: The server refuses the request (authenticated but not permitted).
map.请求的资源不存在。: The requested resource was not found.
map.请求方法不被允许（如对只读资源 POST）。: The request method is not allowed (for example, POST to a read-only resource).
map.客户端未在服务器超时时间内发送请求。: The client did not send a request within the server's timeout.
map.请求与服务器当前状态冲突。: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.
map.资源已永久删除且无转发地址。: The resource was permanently removed and has no forwarding address.
map.请求体超过服务器允许的大小。: The request body exceeds the size the server is willing to accept.
map.请求的 Content-Type 服务器不支持。: The server does not support the request's Content-Type.
map.愚人节彩蛋码（RFC 2324），表示服务器拒绝冲泡咖啡。: An April Fools' easter egg (RFC 2324): the server refuses to brew coffee.
map.请求格式正确但语义错误（如验证失败）。: The request was well-formed but semantically invalid (for example, validation failed).
map.请求频率超过限制（限流）。: The client has sent too many requests (rate limited).
map.服务器遇到未预期的错误。: The server encountered an unexpected error.
map.服务器不支持请求的功能。: The server does not support the requested functionality.
map.网关/代理从上游收到无效响应。: A gateway or proxy received an invalid response from the upstream server.
map.服务器暂时过载或维护中。: The server is temporarily overloaded or under maintenance.
map.网关/代理等待上游响应超时。: A gateway or proxy timed out while waiting for the upstream server.
map.服务器不支持请求的 HTTP 版本。: The server does not support the HTTP version used in the request.
map.客户端需登录才能访问网络（如公共 WiFi）。: The client must sign in to access the network (for example, public Wi-Fi).
